I'm not sure if this is the right place for this post, but I just need to get my thoughts out there. As the title states, I received news about three weeks ago by an ER doctor that I had a 4cm cyst on my left ovary and that I should follow up with my OBGYN. After I was released from the hospital, I made the appointment, which was today at 1pm. Over the last two weeks, I wasn't stressed about it. I had a lot of people tell me they experienced the same thing, and it turned out to be nothing.

I had my ultrasound at 1pm today, and my amazing husband went with me. My OBGYN started off by saying I didn't have a cyst...that they are common to appear and disappear with menstrual cycles. Awesome, huge relief. Then he lets me know he has some not ideal news. Oh no, please do not tell me it might be cancerous or I might have difficulty getting pregnant. There was no mention of cancer, so that's great news.

He tells me I have two tumors on my uterus and wants me to see a fertility specialist. He indicated that they cause pregnancy complications and late term miscarriages. My heart sinks. Yes, I know this situation could be far worse, so I'm thankful. My OBGYN said hopefully they can do a laparoscopy without having to do a full fledged surgery. He did say, "If you were my family member, I'd want you to get them removed." Really, it's just the initial shock of it all. What will this mean for us when we want to try and get pregnant in a few years? My husband just held me and said, "If we can't have children, we will try to adopt and give a child the love and support that they need. The most important thing is that we're here together by each other's sides." That calmed me down and put things into perspective. My mom, dad, and husband are the most supportive people I could ask for. My mom, dad, and I cried, but my mom is very positive and told me, "Honey, if you want children, you will have them one way or the other. You're taking care of your future child right now by addressing this."

I just needed a place to vent to be honest. If you read all this, thank you :).

tl;dr Ultrasound found two tumors on my uterus requiring removal that could impact my chances at pregnancy and increase my risk of a miscarriage.
